newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico stocks reverse gains on market caution.
newsitem.headline: Mexico stocks reverse gains on market caution.

text.p: Mexican stocks were down at midday after modest mid-morning gains faded on a lack of market impetus, dealers said.
"Nothing much is happening, volume is thin and dealers are waiting for the remaining second quarter earnings reports to come out and for the market to define a trend," a floor trader said.
The leading IPC share index was down 16.00 points, or 0.40 percent, at 4,706.42. Trading volume was moderate at 37.4 million shares, 12 million of which were just two cross trades.
The IPC earlier hit 4,755.94 points on short-lived bargain-hunting in the wake of an early dip.
"There was no volume to sustain the mid-morning advance," another floor trader said.
Dealers said media group Televisa and construction firm ICA weighed most on the market.
"They've both been volatile recently, especially with volume this thin. Televisa seems to have overheated after last week's (earnings) report," the trader added.
Televisa was off 2.00 pesos at 114.00 pesos.
"ICA's report this morning seems to have been in line with expectations, but the share hasn't been too popular since the recent split," a floor trader said.
ICA was off 45 centavos at 22.25 pesos.
On the broad market, sliders outweighed gainers by 41 to 37.
